review_unsupported_claims: The obligation assigns the fit determination to the third party ('მესამე მხარემ უნდა განისაზღვროს'); the regulation's passive 'უნდა განისაზღვროს' leaves the determination to the model user after the vendor presents its materials. The proposal repeats the same error.
review_comment: The regulation says „ამის შემდეგ უნდა განისაზღვროს, არის თუ არა მოდელი ... მიზანშეწონილი“, a decision the bank makes at acquisition, not a vendor duty. A quarterly monitoring report would not record it. The real problem in the document (§4.1, the vendor supplies no test results) belongs to the first limb of art9/p4, already covered by Finding 7, so this is a misstated, out-of-scope obligation.

The duty is to increase decision-logic transparency and to be able to explain decisions to customers 'საჭიროების შემთხვევაში'. That is a policy and process obligation, not content a monitoring report must contain. The one transparency problem in the document (§4.2, no score access for M-005) is already raised under art5/p10.1.

review_unsupported_claims: Obligation concerns supervisory models whose changes are reported to the National Bank; M-001 is not shown to be a supervisory model, and the document never says it is. The claim that §2.2.3 'describes the reason and the result' as a change needing supervisory justification is unsupported. The proposal also asserts 'error analysis confirmed the change improves the model', which is invented.
review_comment: art11/p5 applies to supervisory models and sets a duty toward the National Bank: „ვალდებულია დაასაბუთოს ამ ცვლილების საჭიროება“. §2.2.3 only records a lowered approval threshold; nothing marks M-001 as supervisory. The proposal fabricates a conclusion not in the document.

review_unsupported_claims: Evidence cites a quote with an empty string („“) and sections '§—'. PSI is population stability monitoring, not the robustness testing described in art5/p10; calling it 'behaviour under changes of input parameters' is a stretch. The required scenario testing is conditional ('საჭიროების შემთხვევაში').
review_comment: „მოდელის განვითარების აუცილებელი ეტაპია ტესტირება“ is a development-stage first-line duty, not something a quarterly monitoring report documents. The evidence is malformed (an empty quotation, no section) and the proposal inserts development-testing text into the report.

review_unsupported_claims: Evidence cites section '§—' for a table row. The proposal inserts 'the data conform to the model requirements and the chosen methodology', a statement of compliance that the document does not support and that contradicts §3.2.1 and §3.2.2.
review_comment: Data suitability for the chosen methodology is a build-stage matter ('მოდელის აგების ეტაპზე'). The monitoring report in fact discloses the 12.4% missing-value deficiency, which belongs to art8/p1. The proposal asserts fitness for purpose right after a data incident, which would be a false statement.

review_unsupported_claims: Evidence quotes carry no section ('§—') and the second quote is described as covering the 'IFRS 9' model when it is the M-001 table. Claims stability and accuracy are only 'partially' shown, yet the report shows Gini (accuracy), PSI (stability) and actual/predicted ratios (calibration); the drift gap is not a requirement of the report. The proposal invents an empty 'Drift' row with placeholders.
review_comment: The clause lists factors for the entity's risk-ranking methodology for validation planning, not content for a monitoring report. In any case the report covers stability („სტაბილურობა (PSI)“) and accuracy (Gini) at length, so 'partial' is unwarranted.

review_unsupported_claims: §5.1 concerns the justification of expert adjustments, not qualitative evaluation of the information used in model development; the link is forced.
review_comment: The duty concerns conceptual-soundness review of the qualitative information and reasoning used in model development (validation scope), which is not a monitoring-report requirement. The system cites §5.1, „კორექტირებების 92% დასაბუთებულია“, which the expert key marks as a compliant section that should not be flagged. The proposal adds an unsupported claim that such an evaluation took place.

review_unsupported_claims: Reuses the same §5.1 evidence as the previous finding; it is a duplicate of the second sentence of art6/p5/sა.გ. The proposal asserts the procedure 'is argued and properly documented', with no basis in the document.
review_comment: This is the validation-process assurance duty for qualitative review; the report neither performs nor describes it. §5.1 is marked as a compliant section that should not be flagged. The proposed text merely declares compliance without evidence.
